overal.goal: After a state change the URL must update so it never shows an invalid route (owner, 2026-10-30). Today switching the project shows an error on the screen: the page keeps a URL that belongs to the previous project (for example a task id or plan id that does not exist in the new project). When the project changes, navigate to that project's equivalent screen (its Overview, Tasks list or Plans list — drop ids that belong to the old project); when a task or plan is deleted, archived away or not found, replace the URL with its list; generally every state change that makes the current URL invalid replaces it (history replace, not push) with the nearest valid one.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first where the change is logic (src/lib, server); keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check . && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
Reproduce the project-switch error first and pin it with a test before fixing it.
Use history replace for corrections so the Back button does not return to the invalid URL.
rules.dont: Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.
Do not show an error screen for a URL the app itself made invalid.

versions.version: Requested by the owner on 2026-10-30; not started.

tests.strategy: A test per transition (project switch from a task, a plan and settings; task deleted while open; unknown id in a pasted URL); a browser check of the project switch.
